title: Find gene orthologs — orthologs
text: genes character vector gene symbols NCBI/Ensembl gene IDs (case-sensitive). source Species genes, "mouse". See species(). target Species find orthologs. synonyms TRUE (default), check gene synonyms inputs direct match. best TRUE (default), keep best matches, can differ search directions. min_support Minimum number methods sources support gene pair. Use one positive whole number. maximum possible count depends species pair. orthologs_only TRUE (default), keep inputs least one matching pair.

title: rthologs: Gene Orthologs for Model Organisms in a Tidy Data Format — rthologs-package
text: Genomic analysis frequently involves comparisons human mouse data. requires harmonization gene names gene space. 'rthologs' R package simplifies cross-species conversion mapping gene orthologs/homologs common model organisms human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, fly. supports gene symbols, NCBI (Entrez) IDs, Ensembl IDs, works offline. orthologs sourced Alliance Genome Resources (AGR) doi:10.1093/genetics/iyae049 .
